system.description:
You hold your weapon in a perfect perpendicular stance as you wait for the moment to strike. First, mark a creature within range. Then, until the beginning of your next turn, when that marked creature would cast a jutsu or make an attack against a creature other than you while in your weapon’s range, you strike out making a Taijutsu attack against the triggering creature based on the type of weapon you are wielding. On a hit you deal your [Weapon’s damage] + 1d12.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d12.
